Job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, a Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Two sweeps have already covered pan-European remote keyword searches. Your slice is **geography he can reach on foot or with a short move**: Italy first, then Spain and Portugal.

## Candidate profile (never invent beyond this)
- ~3 years experience across eight European companies. **Indian passport, Italian EU long-term residence permit** -> no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU. NOT UK, Swiss or US authorised.
- Lives in Venice (Via Zanetti 10, 30175). **Confirmed open to an office in any EU city, and to Spain specifically.**
- **Italian: beginner, actively studying.** This is the key constraint for your slice. Two near-perfect roles were already lost to Italian-language requirements. So: report roles where the working language is English, or where Italian is listed as nice-to-have, and flag the language line VERBATIM on every row. A role requiring fluent or native Italian is a rejection, not a find - but say so in the rejected list, because he is weighing whether B1 Italian is worth a 2026 project and the count matters to that decision.
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier, RAG, LLM agents, Docker, AWS basics.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024 to ongoing) - grew platform 2,000 to 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture and enrichment, GTM/outbound automations, scraping/parsing pipeline. Also Urlink (built a platform largely with AI as PM and developer), UltraStrategy (CV-parsing tool in n8n + Eden AI), Clubee (API integration, unit testing, QA).
- **No GitHub. No CS degree** (BA Philosophy/International Studies/Economics, Ca' Foscari Venice - an Italian degree, which is worth noting to Italian employers). No Java, no Go/Rust, no Python backend depth, no Kubernetes.
- Salary target EUR 30,000-40,000 (note: this is realistic-to-good for the Italian market, unlike the German one). Contract EUR 200/day. Sole trader on an Italian Partita IVA, NOT a limited company.

## Your slice
**Italy (priority):** Milan, Rome, Turin, Bologna, Padua, Venice, Verona, Trento, Florence, Naples, plus Italy-remote. Italian tech companies and scale-ups, and international companies with an Italian entity. Search in **both English and Italian** - Italian-language queries surface postings the English ones miss. Useful Italian query terms: "sviluppatore full stack remoto", "ingegnere AI", "automazione processi", "sviluppatore Next.js", "consulente automazione", "smart working sviluppatore".

**Then Spain and Portugal:** Barcelona, Madrid, Valencia, Lisbon, Porto, plus Spain-remote and Portugal-remote. English-working-language roles only unless Spanish is nice-to-have.

**Hosts** (WebSearch `allowed_domains` is a hard filter): `jobs.ashbyhq.com`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io`, `job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io`, `jobs.lever.co`, `jobs.eu.lever.co`, `join.com`, `jobs.workable.com`, `jobs.smartrecruiters.com`, `jobs.personio.com`, `jobs.recruitee.com`, `jobs.teamtailor.com`, `euremotejobs.com`, `it.indeed.com`, `www.infojobs.it`, `it.linkedin.com`, `www.tecnichenuove.com`. If a host will not render, say so rather than guessing.

**Bias hard toward postings dated within the last 21 days.**

## Verification is the whole job
Fetch-based verification failed badly last sweep: four top-scoring finds were listed as live by `api.ashbyhq.com` yet returned "Job not found" in a real browser. Ashby pages are client-rendered and a deleted URL still serves its old page title, so a title match proves nothing. WebFetch every posting URL, confirm it renders as ONE live posting not a board index, and **state your confidence per row with what you actually saw**.

## Exclusion list - already applied to, closed, gated or logged. NEVER report these again:
Arize AI, Arkipel, Attio, Ben, Bullpen Talent, Camunda, Checkly, Codex, Cohere, Cresta, Dash0, Duvo, EggAI, ElevenLabs, Eneba, Filigran, Fueled, G2i, GRAI, GTM Base, Gensyn, Glacis AI, Goldsky, HiPeople, Jamie, JobLeads, Kairos, Lovable, Mercura, Mindrift, Toloka AI, Moneyfarm, Musixmatch, MyEdSpace, Novosafe, Nuitee, Oh, OpenHands, Parloa, Pinnipedia, Quadrivia, Reedsy, Reflow, Remote People, Runpod, SalesCaptain, Satispay, Shippeo, Sourcegraph, Supabase, The Flex, The Global Talent Co, Unframe, Viktor, YLD, Zapier, dexter health, n8n, neptune.ai, peopleIX, Laioutr, salesHAX, RevOS, cargovibe, KFS GROUP, tem, Nearform, Aircall, Always Friday, Outliant, ClickHouse, Twilio, Neural Earth, Atmen, MAIA, alago, Stackgini, Cognite, Pragmatike, Starbridge, supermodular.ai, indigo.ai.

## Scoring (total 100)
role match 30 + eligibility and work basis 25 + stack overlap 20 + seniority realism 15 + signal quality 10. Eligibility is nearly free in your slice, so the differentiator is language and stack. Deduct heavily where Italian or Spanish fluency is required.

## Output - return this and nothing else
One block per role scoring 55+:

### <score> - <role title> · <company>
- **Where:** <verbatim location sentence> · Tier 1 / 2 / 3 · Employee or Contract
- **Language:** <the verbatim language requirement line, or "none stated">
- **Pay:** <figures or "not disclosed"> · **Posted:** <date or "not stated">
- **Why:** two or three sentences tied to specific things he has actually done.
- **Watch-outs:** the honest gaps, named.
- **Apply:** <canonical application URL>
- **Verified:** <what you fetched, what you saw, your confidence>

Then: a **"lost to Italian-language requirements"** list with a count (he needs this number), a "dead or unverifiable" list, and the queries you ran. No preamble.
